{"self_assessment": "Impact: I fetched a full 40-domino load for the shared bin at the start, so the table had material from the first minute. I then laid the front half of the fish's bottom line, tracing it from the start area along the belly. I also spotted that the bottom line needed a join fixed at the body end so it would receive the fall, and I sorted that out. That helped bring the whole outline into one connected run. Before the push, the run was confirmed to fall from start to finish, all 143 dominoes, and the fish read clearly as a fish.

Execution: I worked steadily in batches along the sketched stroke. I used close inspections at the right moments to check where the chain was connected and where it wasn't. I extended the lower fork from the body end toward the tail, and I stood back up what needed it. I kept my hands off the finished run before the push so nothing got bumped.

Collaboration: I agreed a clear split on the bottom line with Priya, with me taking the front half to the belly and her taking the back half. This kept us out of each other's way. When she asked me to hang back from the fork, I did, and I moved to checking joins around the tail. I offered help to Leo on the fork break and kept the table updated on what I was doing.

Leadership: I set the pace early by committing to supply the bin and then following through. I kept the plan simple, with everyone on a defined piece, and I called for hands-off before the push. That protected the finished fish.", "my_share_percent": 30}
